from zipfile import ZipFile, ZIP_DEFLATED
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
import shutil, os, tempfile

ppt=Path('/home/user/Desktop/4_1.pptx')
backup=ppt.with_suffix('.pptx.bak')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(ppt, backup)

NS_P='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main'
NS_A='http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'
ET.register_namespace('a', NS_A)
ET.register_namespace('p', NS_P)
ET.register_namespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('mc', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')

ET.register_namespace('p15', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main')
ET.register_namespace('p16', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2014/main')
ET.register_namespace('p17', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2017/main')
ET.register_namespace('p188', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2018/8/main')
ET.register_namespace('p188c', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2018/8/creationId')
ET.register_namespace('adec', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2017/decorative')
ET.register_namespace('a16', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2014/main')
ET.register_namespace('a14', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2010/main')
ET.register_namespace('am3d', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/drawing/2017/model3d')
ET.register_namespace('o', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office')
ET.register_namespace('v', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:vml')
ET.register_namespace('mv', 'urn:schemas-microsoft-com:mac:vml')

ns={'p':NS_P,'a':NS_A}
targets={2:'How to Use This Presentation',3:'Add a Roadmap Page',5:'Write your topic or idea'}
changed=[]

def q(ns, tag):
    return f'{{{ns}}}{tag}'

with ZipFile(ppt, 'r') as zin:
    fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='pptx-edit-', suffix='.pptx', dir=str(ppt.parent))
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with ZipFile(tmpname, 'w', ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for info in zin.infolist():
                data = zin.read(info.filename)
                if info.filename in [f'ppt/slides/slide{i}.xml' for i in targets]:
                    slide_no=int(info.filename.rsplit('slide',1)[1].split('.xml')[0])
                    root=ET.fromstring(data)
                    target=targets[slide_no]
                    matched=False
                    for sp in root.findall('.//p:sp', ns):
                        text=''.join((t.text or '') for t in sp.findall('.//a:t', ns)).strip()
                        if text == target:
                            matched=True
                            for r in sp.findall('.//a:r', ns):
                                rPr=r.find('a:rPr', ns)
                                if rPr is None:
                                    rPr=ET.Element(q(NS_A,'rPr'))
                                    r.insert(0, rPr)
                                rPr.set('u','sng')
                                # Remove direct fill choices so black is unambiguous.
                                for child in list(rPr):
                                    if child.tag in {q(NS_A,'solidFill'), q(NS_A,'gradFill'), q(NS_A,'noFill'), q(NS_A,'pattFill'), q(NS_A,'blipFill'), q(NS_A,'grpFill')}:
                                        rPr.remove(child)
                                solid=ET.Element(q(NS_A,'solidFill'))
                                srgb=ET.SubElement(solid, q(NS_A,'srgbClr'))
                                srgb.set('val','000000')
                                rPr.insert(0, solid)
                            # Also update end paragraph properties if PowerPoint/LibreOffice use them for inherited style.
                            for end in sp.findall('.//a:endParaRPr', ns):
                                end.set('u','sng')
                                for child in list(end):
                                    if child.tag in {q(NS_A,'solidFill'), q(NS_A,'gradFill'), q(NS_A,'noFill'), q(NS_A,'pattFill'), q(NS_A,'blipFill'), q(NS_A,'grpFill')}:
                                        end.remove(child)
                                solid=ET.Element(q(NS_A,'solidFill'))
                                srgb=ET.SubElement(solid, q(NS_A,'srgbClr'))
                                srgb.set('val','000000')
                                end.insert(0, solid)
                    if not matched:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'Title not found on slide {slide_no}: {target}')
                    changed.append((slide_no,target))
                    data=ET.tostring(root, encoding='utf-8', xml_declaration=True)
                zout.writestr(info, data)
        os.replace(tmpname, ppt)
    except Exception:
        try: os.unlink(tmpname)
        except FileNotFoundError: pass
        raise
print('changed:', changed)
print('backup:', backup)
PY"
